evidenceContract.userBehavior: Request a concise 60-second concept PV design in the conversation from an actual screenplay, without making the media-production Skill impersonate preparation or generation capabilities.

observables.description: Exact Skill receipt, configured model, screenplay evidence, creator-useful PV design and absent production side effects.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The concise response contains one concept paragraph with no evidence inventory and at most four cross-shot invariants, followed by one six-to-eight-beat authoritative 60-second sequence. Any downstream handoff is limited to stable creative decisions, source references and continuity requirements.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Nested analysis, evidence, sound, production, technology, key-shot, acceptance or creator-question mini-sections; one row per camera action; repeated decisions; prompt packets; guessed operation or parameter names; invented story facts; an unapproved scope change; or production Tool use fails.

steps.prompt:
$media-production 读取 @screenplay.fountain
只需要一份供创作者确认方向的 60 秒动画概念 PV。不要准备模型输入，不要生成媒体或修改项目。
